Felix Pristine — Wave 8 (CI-hardening finish)

Status: SURVEYING. This is the wave's living story — each phase appends. Wave 7 landed 3 slices (#2954/#2956 + phantom-media #2955), all MERGED 2026-07-13; this wave does NOT re-handle them.

The wish

Kill the flaky / only-growing test infrastructure that has been reddening merge trains. Cut this wave from the OPEN backlog children the wave-7 review filed. Three test-infra slices, each its own opus worktree/PR with a fail-before protective test that REPRODUCES the flake (a flake fix with no reproduction is vacuous-green); gates green (CC=/usr/bin/clang mix test). Finishing over net-new; every change names a concrete failure mode; zero cosmetic churn.

Strategic direction

Finished experience: a rebased PR's Test gate reds ONLY on its own change — never on infrastructure noise. Today three pre-existing hazards poison the merge train: (1) an order-dependent global-atom-table race + a wall-clock rate-limiter-window flake that surface as intermittent 429s; (2) a Sobelow baseline that only GROWS via append-only --mark-skip-all, so a code line-shift drifts it and re-adds dead fossils; (3) a sibling 40P01 migration-DDL deadlock from an un-Sandbox.allow'd Ecto.Migrator connection Task. This is a FINISH-THE-BACKLOG wave: build exactly the three filed children, no fresh audit, no scope creep.

The quality bar (Kinsta/Vercel): a green suite means the code is good — not that the dice landed right. Every slice must convert a probabilistic red into a deterministic one. The reproduction test is the deliverable's spine: seed-pinned, order-forced, or contention-forced so it reds BEFORE the fix and greens AFTER. A fix whose test cannot reproduce the flake is rejected as vacuous-green.

The three slices (all opus — Fable is exhausted this wave)

SLICE 1 — task-felix-suite-order-flakes (P4). content_probe_test.exs:83 asserts :erlang.system_info(:atom_count) == before under async:true — it races the GLOBAL VM atom table against every concurrent test (83136 vs 83135). pulse_public_surface_test.exs:122 asserts exactly 3 of N concurrent burst requests get 200; a wall-clock rate-limiter window occasionally lets 4 through. Fix direction: stop asserting a global atom-count delta under async (serialize the one assertion or make it tolerant to concurrent minting), and assert <=N (or drive the limiter deterministically) for the burst. Reproduction: force concurrency/contention so the flake reds before the fix.

SLICE 2 — task-felix-sobelow-baseline-reconcile (P3, ADVISORY gate — Sobelow is continue-on-error in security.yml, so this is hygiene, never a merge blocker). mix sobelow --mark-skip-all is APPEND-ONLY: it never drops a fingerprint whose finding has moved/disappeared, so api/.sobelow-skips only grows and a line-shift drifts the baseline. origin/main is currently 84 lines (already pruned by #2956 from 193 — the task's '193 lines / 63% dead' figure is STALE, re-measure on a fresh regen). Ship a reconcile-not-append regen step (make/CI target or small script) that REPLACES the baseline with only currently-live fingerprints, and a guard proving a freshly-added un-skipped finding STILL reds mix sobelow --skip --exit Low (no blanket-suppress).

SLICE 3 — task-felix-migrator-task-sandbox-race (P3). Two @tag :flaky migration tests (codelist_issue_version_test.exs, restore_search_null_dataset_dedup_test.exs) are excluded by default for a sandbox-escaping-Task bug: Ecto.Migrator.up/3 spawns its OWN connection Task for the migration body BEFORE Sandbox.allow/3 shares the owner pid, so it races on checkout, intermittent 40P01. DISTINCT from wave-7's D35 audit-dispatch deadlock fix (that toggle covers Dispatcher.fan_out, NOT Migrator internals). Fix (as the tests' own comments prescribe): share the sandbox owner pid with the Migrator's spawned task, then drop :flaky. Acceptance = N>=10 full-suite runs with 0 40P01. NOTE: restore_search's comment says it drives via apply_up/1 / apply_down/1 (NOT Ecto.Migrator) — surveyor must confirm whether that test actually hits the Migrator-spawned-Task path, because the two tests may need different treatment.

Guardrails (from the lead + charter)

Branch from ORIGIN/main — the local checkout is DIVERGED ~112 ahead with omx commits; never build from it. Main checkout stays on main; all builds in isolated worktrees. CC=/usr/bin/clang (cc is a Claude wrapper). mix test is NOT blocked by dev-boot OOM/registry blockers (test.exs disables the codelist seeder). Every builder_model = opus; decompose a too-hard slice into smaller opus slices, NEVER Fable, NEVER Haiku. Publish wall: content.tags = 1-12 single-line {tag, distinct strength 1-100, rationale >=20 chars} with registry-known tags. Charter is the rotating slot bp-cloud-epic-charter.md (holds Felix); Decide commits it AND ensures it reaches origin/main; never pipe cherry-pick to tail in an && chain.

Survey plan (in flight)

Casting a wide net across the three slices: exact flake mechanisms + reproduction levers, the sandbox/DataCase setup seam, Sobelow tooling seam + how other Elixir shops reconcile baselines, prior art in Barkpark papers/tasks (epic tree + wave-5/6/7 charter decisions D14/D29/D35), and adjacent constraints (async:true flip history, ExUnit.OnExitHandler ownership hazard from D14). Each question and its why is enumerated in the survey assignments.

Digest appends the survey digest + verify plan here BEFORE verifiers fly. Decide appends decisions + wave plan BEFORE builders fly. Review closes this story as the debrief. Slices driven: task-felix-suite-order-flakes, task-felix-sobelow-baseline-reconcile, task-felix-migrator-task-sandbox-race. Epic: task-96a908af98698118.

Survey digest (12 reports folded — DIGEST phase)

What is now ESTABLISHED, file:line-anchored. SLICE 1 mechanism is fully pinned with in-repo fix precedent. content_probe_test.exs:9 is async:true; line 81-83 asserts GLOBAL :erlang.system_info(:atom_count) unchanged around a content_get call. content_get is provably atom-safe (content_probe.ex:82-96 — only String.to_existing_atom + rescue), so the delta comes from ANY other concurrent test minting an atom on the shared VM table (e.g. content/validation.ex:109, tasks/validation.ex:147, both String.to_atom). Fix: replace the global-counter check with a key-specific proof — assert_raise ArgumentError on String.to_existing_atom(key) — deterministic under any scheduling, keeps async:true. Flipping to async:false is NOT a reliable fix (ExUnit sync-loop is not temporally isolated from the async pool). pulse_public_surface_test.exs:122 asserts exactly 3-of-4 burst POSTs=200; the limiter is a continuous-refill token bucket (rate_limiter.ex:50-68, System.monotonic_time, no clock seam), test-storm fixture burst=3 refill=10 tok/sec, so ~100ms of real round-trip latency refills a 4th token. Fix: assert <=@burst AND require a 429 present — sibling pulse_abuse_drill_test.exs:60 ALREADY does `assert two_hundreds <= @burst`. Both slice-1 files are OUTSIDE the async-flip's 54-file blast radius (dd0c27ce --stat) and pulse is the charter D4 keep-serial exemplar — zero collision risk.

SLICE 2 root cause + native mechanism confirmed from dep source. --mark-skip-all opens api/.sobelow-skips in :append mode (sobelow.ex:512), never prunes; the fingerprint is phash2([type,source,filename,vuln_line_no]) (finding.ex:53-63) — line-anchored, so any line shift orphans an entry. No native single-flag reconcile exists: the reconcile IS `mix sobelow --clear-skip` (File.rm!, sobelow.ex:463-471) THEN `mix sobelow --mark-skip-all` (regenerate from live findings only). origin/main baseline is 84 lines (the task's 193/63%-dead figure is STALE — #2956 already pruned to 84). At least 3 confirmed dead CI.System fossils from #2954 (validator.ex:72, self_update/runner.ex:114, studio_chat/probe.ex:197 — the live code moved to inline `# sobelow_skip` at :127/:171/:217); the 4th CI.System entry titles.ex:366 is still LIVE. Guard test is cheap: sobelow scans source directly (utils.ex:34-36, no compile), and DOS.StringToAtom forces :low confidence for any non-controller module (string_to_atom.ex:20) — plant a throwaway non-controller `def leak(k), do: String.to_atom(k)` fixture, prove `mix sobelow --skip --exit Low` reds, delete it. The gate is ADVISORY (security.yml continue-on-error) — never blocks merge.

SLICE 3 — the task PREMISE is factually contested by a UNANIMOUS survey finding, and this is the wave's crux. The task says BOTH files share the Ecto.Migrator-spawned-Task race and BOTH should drop @tag :flaky. FALSE: only ONE test — codelist_issue_version_test.exs Fixture E (lines 190-244) — actually calls Ecto.Migrator.up/3. Codelist Fixtures A-D and BOTH restore_search tests drive via apply_up/1 directly (in-process, same sandbox connection, no Task spawned); restore_search's own comment (lines 39-41) says it AVOIDS Migrator on purpose. So :flaky on 6 of 7 tests looks defensive/copy-pasted, not evidence of this race. DEEPER CONTEST: the Migrator-race THEORY may be wrong even for Fixture E — DataCase already puts async:false tests in Sandbox SHARED mode (start_owner!(shared: not tags[:async])) which auto-covers any spawned process, and stdlib Task.async propagates $callers (Elixir >=1.8) which DBConnection.Ownership checks (ownership.ex:54-64). There is NO public Migrator option to inject an owner pid (its Task.async is private/unexported), so an allow-based fix may have nothing to act on. And NO 40P01 stack trace exists anywhere in the repo — the flake is comment-asserted only; :flaky is excluded from default mix test (test_helper.exs:47-55). CONFOUND: D35's audit-dispatch 40P01 fix (a DIFFERENT flake) is UNMERGED on origin/main (60966bdc not an ancestor; dispatcher.ex has no audit_dispatch_async) — a second 40P01 source is STILL LIVE, so slice-3 evidence MUST attribute any hit by stack (Migrator DDL vs Dispatcher.fan_out SELECT), exactly D29's warning.

Harness reality (governs slice-3 acceptance). Command: `cd api && CC=/usr/bin/clang mix test`. CI Test step ~5.5min warm; isolated local ~220-248s; under load 14-19 runtime inflated 2.2x with spurious pool-timeouts. This box is CURRENTLY load 53-77 with ~20 worktrees — a naive N>=10 full-suite loop locally is impractical (>1hr) and manufactures noise. Precedent (the already-closed D35 task) treated N>=10 full-suite as CI/lead merge-gated, with the deterministic protective test as PRIMARY proof. The borrow-warm-_build recipe (copy api/_build/test + symlink deps) works. For slice-3 the honest reproduction is a targeted/forced contention repro against Fixture E, not a natural full-suite loop.

CONTRADICTIONS / tensions for DECIDE. (1) Slice-3 premise vs surveys: the fix shape depends ENTIRELY on whether the flake reproduces — Decide MUST re-scope slice-3 acceptance criteria into two distinct claims: (A) Fixture E — repro-or-prove-already-covered, fix only if a real Migrator-owner 40P01 fires; (B) the 6 non-Migrator tests — detag ONLY with N>=10 --include flaky evidence, and if any genuinely flakes for a distinct cause, split it to a NEW backlog task rather than fold it into a vacuous close. (2) atom_count fix: keep async:true + assert_raise rewrite (favored — more precise, sidesteps the async-isolation question) vs serialize. (3) sobelow true dead-count unknown beyond the 3 confirmed CI.System fossils until a fresh regen runs.

Coverage map — checked & FOUND

SLICE 1: content_probe_test.exs, content_probe.ex, content/validation.ex:109, tasks/validation.ex:147, pulse_public_surface_test.exs, rate_limiter.ex, pulse_controller.ex, config/test.exs (test-storm + abuse-rate fixtures), pulse_abuse_drill_test.exs:60 (<=@burst precedent), rate_limit.ex scope hatch, conn_case.ex, test_helper.exs, async-flip commit dd0c27ce --stat. SLICE 2: .sobelow-skips (origin/main 84 lines), sobelow.ex (clear/mark impl), finding.ex (line-anchored hash), utils.ex (source scan), string_to_atom.ex (forced :low), security.yml (advisory), merge-gates.md, mix.exs (no alias), Makefile (no target), #2954 commit 841fc284 + inline-skip sites, titles.ex:366 still live. SLICE 3: codelist_issue_version_test.exs (Fixture E vs A-D), restore_search test + both migration modules, data_case.ex (setup_sandbox + drain), ecto_sql migrator.ex + sandbox.ex, db_connection ownership.ex ($callers), charter D14/D29/D35/D38, D35 commit 60966bdc UNMERGED, test_helper.exs flaky exclude.

Coverage map — checked & NOT FOUND (absences = decisions-in-waiting)

(1) NO surveyor could run bp full-text prior-art search — every survey hit `bp search: unknown command`. The Barkpark papers/tasks knowledge base was NOT searched for prior art on any slice (the charter + task bodies stood in). Corner unreached: any prior paper specifically on these three flakes. (2) NOBODY RAN ANYTHING — all 12 surveys were read-only. Zero empirical confirmation that any flake reproduces, that the reconcile runs on this toolchain, or that the guard fixture reds. This is precisely why the verify fleet below is RUN-heavy — distrust vacuous green. (3) NO 40P01 stack trace exists in the repo — the migrator flake is comment-asserted only. (4) The other ~80 non-CI.System sobelow lines (Traversal.FileModule ~50, XSS 4, Config 9, SQL 7, DOS 6, RCE 1) were NOT individually checked for deadness — real dead count unknown until a fresh regen. (5) restore_search's actual flake behavior (does it EVER fail, or is the tag purely defensive?) was never executed. (6) The ExUnit sync-loop-vs-async-pool temporal-concurrency claim (load-bearing for 'async:false won't fix atom_count') is asserted from general OTP knowledge, not verified against this repo's Elixir/OTP.

Verify plan — 4 opus assignments IN FLIGHT (all RUN, distrust vacuous green)

V1 [opus, worktree, RUN] — SLICE-3 CRUX: does the migrator 40P01 actually reproduce? In an isolated worktree off origin/main (the 5 target files are byte-identical to origin/main — verify via git diff first), loop codelist Fixture E + restore_search --include flaky (20 seeds) and under concurrent load; capture any 40P01 / DBConnection.OwnershipError and its EXACT stack (Migrator DDL vs distinct cause). If NO repro -> slice-3 reframes to 'prove-already-covered + detag with N>=10 evidence'; if YES -> capture whether owner-pid sharing is the fix or a distinct cause. Then plant a throwaway non-controller String.to_atom(k) fixture under lib/, run `mix sobelow --skip --exit Low`, confirm NONZERO exit (fresh finding reds), delete fixture + restore baseline. PROVES both the reconcile mechanism and the guard on this exact toolchain.

V3 [opus, worktree, RUN] — SLICE-1: prove both fail-before reproductions are constructible. atom_count: force the current line-83 assertion to red (spawn a Task minting a fresh atom in the window, or run alongside an atom-minting async module) and confirm the assert_raise-on-to_existing_atom(key) rewrite is green under the same forcing. pulse: inject Process.sleep(~120ms) between the 4 burst POSTs so a 4th token refills, confirm the current `==3` reds and `<=@burst`+429-present holds. RUN both targeted mix test invocations. PROVES neither slice-1 fix is vacuous-green.

Confirm D35's audit_dispatch_async is absent from origin/main (`git show origin/main:api/lib/barkpark/webhooks/dispatcher.ex | grep -c audit_dispatch_async` -> 0), so a second live 40P01 source exists. Confirm the exact @tag:flaky inventory across both slice-3 files and that only Fixture E calls Ecto.Migrator. Draft the re-scoped slice-3 acceptance-criteria wording (crit A Fixture E repro-or-cover; crit B the 6 tests detag-with-evidence, split-if-distinct). Drives tasks: task-felix-suite-order-flakes (S1), task-felix-sobelow-baseline-reconcile (S2), task-felix-migrator-task-sandbox-race (S3). Epic: task-96a908af98698118.

Status: DECIDED (building). Decide folded the 4 verify reports + 12 surveys into decisions D39-D44 and cut 3 opus slices. The verify round OVERTURNED two premises baked into the wish — recorded below.

Verification results (proofs > facts > prose)

V1 — SLICE-3 CRUX (migrator 40P01), RUN, 20 seeds. REFUTED the premise twice over. (a) NO 40P01 reproduces: 0/20 seeds, and a repo-wide grep for 40P01|deadlock_detected is EMPTY — the label is comment-only, so 'N>=10 runs 0 40P01' is trivially already met. (b) What reproduces is DETERMINISTIC, not flaky: Fixture E (the ONLY Ecto.Migrator caller, codelist_issue_version_test.exs:207/222) fails 20/20 with a DBConnection.ConnectionError checkout timeout, stack rooted at 'ecto_sql migrator.ex:354 run_maybe_in_transaction <- Task.Supervised.invoke_mfa'. Root cause: the parent holds the migration advisory lock (a transaction) on the single SHARED sandbox conn (data_case.ex:82 shared: not async), so the Migrator's Task.async|>Task.await child queues behind it -> ~970ms checkout timeout. NOT an ownership gap (shared mode already shares the conn; $callers already propagates), so the task's Sandbox.allow fix CANNOT work. The '193 lines / 63% dead' + '~80 dead entries' hypotheses are REFUTED — the baseline is ~93% live, only 6 dead fossils (3 CI.System line-shifted by #2954 + 3 Traversal). GUARD PROVEN: planting `def leak(k), do: String.to_atom(k)` -> `mix sobelow --skip --exit Low` exit 1 (DOS.StringToAtom :low); removing it -> exit 0. Gate is ADVISORY (continue-on-error).

V3 — SLICE-1 (fail-before repros), RUN. content_probe: FULLY constructible — forcing a concurrent atom mint reds line-83 (left 36102 right 36097); the assert_raise-on-to_existing_atom rewrite greens (13 tests 0 failures) under the same forcing, async:true kept. pulse: the repro AS SPECIFIED (Process.sleep 120ms + <=@burst on test-storm) is NOT constructible — test-storm is 10 tok/sec, 120ms over-refills to 1.2 tokens so all 4 POSTs return 200 [200,200,200,200], reding BOTH ==3 AND <=@burst and removing the 429.
